name: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
instructions: Mix paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, salt, and pepper into a dry rub.
Rub all over the pork shoulder generously.
Place pork in slow cooker. Mix BBQ sauce, vinegar, and brown sugar, pour over pork.
Cook on LOW 8 hours or HIGH 5 hours until meat is fall-apart tender.
Remove pork and shred with two forks. Discard excess fat.
Return shredded pork to slow cooker and mix with juices. Serve on buns.

substitutions.gluten_free: Use gluten-free BBQ sauce and serve on gluten-free buns.
substitutions.low_carb: Skip the buns and serve over coleslaw.

notes: Leftovers keep 4 days refrigerated. Excellent for meal prep.
